mechanism_narrative: Rising employment (PAYEMS) signals labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in normal labor markets are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in tightening cycles are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS crossing above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in GDP demand (GDPC1) signal monetary easing, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected surge in unemployment rate above 4.2% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during labor market stress are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) despite UNRATE crossing above 4.2%.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion characterized by high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0) and over-supplied goods (INDPRO > 105), S&P 500 forward returns turn negative over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in late-cycle expansion periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) despite high CPIAUCSL and INDPRO values.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both personal consumption (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in expanding demand cycles are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite rising GDPC1 and HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in the goods price index (INDPRO falling below 100) signals supply-side weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns during supply contraction are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) despite INDPRO falling below 100.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market crisis marked by high unemployment (UNRATE > 4.5%) and declining employment (PAYEMS < 148177), S&P 500 forward returns turn negative over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during labor market crises are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) despite high UNRATE and low PAYEMS.
